item.description: Today we are releasing a patch version v2.3.6 for WPPConnect with Bug Fixes, Performance Improvements, Build System and Chores.
item.content:encoded:
Today we are releasing a patch version v2.3.6 for WPPConnect with Bug Fixes, Performance Improvements, Build System and Chores.

2.3.6 (2026-10-23)​

Bug Fixes​

  • auth: keep unpaired QR sessions out of chat readiness (8f46042)
  • auth: mark restored sessions as logged before waiting for chat (366e3c0)
  • auth: only report disconnectedMobile after a real unpair (111633b)
  • browser: apply default launch args and opt-in protection bypasses (c2e0c06)
  • browser: auto-close when only blank or closed tabs remain (c165218)
  • browser: release the browser process tree on close and failed create (b1407bf)
  • deps: require wa-js 4.7.2 for unread actions (6b2a41b)
  • host: guard exposeFunction against reused pages (a778f5a)
  • media: bound resource use in file and download helpers (5f5d9de)

Performance Improvements​

  • decrypt: decode media buffers directly instead of per-byte loops (b03a29d)
  • group: fetch group member contacts in a single page call (a41709e)
  • polling: remove idle polling from live sessions (de07dab)

Build System​

  • deps-dev: bump markdown-it from 14.3.2 to 14.3.3 (7698abf)

item.title: WA-JS minor release: v4.7.0
item.description: Today we are releasing minor version v4.7.0 for WA-JS with Features, Bug Fixes, Build System, Continuous Integration and Chores.
item.content:encoded:
Today we are releasing minor version v4.7.0 for WA-JS with Features, Bug Fixes, Build System, Continuous Integration and Chores.

Highlights​

  • Fix Pix key messages and preserve native payment payloads in WPP.chat.sendPixKeyMessage.
  • Fix native-flow buttons, group sender-key messages, and files with interactive buttons.
  • Avoid preloading the native attachment preview UI, resolving the media selection problem reported in #3716.
  • Return custom lists in synchronized device order with WPP.lists.list(), including orderIndex.
  • Add WPP.lists.setOrder(listIds) to reorder custom lists through WhatsApp's native persistence action. Pass every custom list ID exactly once; built-in list positions and colors are preserved. WhatsApp must enable list reordering for the account.
const ids = WPP.lists.list().map(list => list.id);
await WPP.lists.setOrder(ids.reverse());

Validated with 179 unit tests, including 15 ordering cases, and all 59 pull request checks. Authenticated phone synchronization and real message sending were not tested in this release run.

4.7.0 (2026-10-14)​

Features​

  • chat: support native flow commerce messages (6842e38)
  • lists: permite definir e alterar a cor das listas (#3657) (879f324), closes #3657 #3661 #3662 #3652 #3663 #3664 #3667 #3666 #3669 #3671 #3670 #3672 #3676 #3675 #3678 #3660 #3679 #3654 #3677 #3681 #3683 #3682 #3680 #3684 #3686 #3688 #3691 #3692 #3693 #3685 #3695 #3694 #3697 #3698 #3699 #3700 #3701
  • lists: read and persist synchronized list order (6557e97)

Bug Fixes​

  • call: expose incoming group call identifier (#3725) (60732f6), closes #3725
  • catalog: support options-object product creation (#3723) (4e8707f), closes #3723
  • chat: do not corrupt the group stanza when splitting button encryptions (af7bfa4)
  • chat: isolate native flow sends and preserve payment payloads (12c8c2f)
  • chat: keep interactive header when sending files with buttons (8222449)
  • chat: keep the native_flow_name attribute biz of payment messages (61c3e1b)
  • chat: send carousel messages with the native flow biz node (20f27ba)
  • chat: send legacy list messages to groups with the list stanza shape (#3722) (cb53dd5), closes #3722
  • chat: send native flow biz node as v=9 mixed (2d7f36a)
  • chat: send the native flow biz node on group sender-key messages (75e328e), closes #1235
  • lists: serialize native reorder mutations (62a1479)
  • lists: use numeric ids in reorder sync payloads (87e8290)
  • loader: avoid preloading native attachment preview UI (#3718) (c457a60), closes #3718
  • loader: skip WAWebMoment locale modules when enumerating modules (#3704) (6537820), closes #3704
  • resolve status privacy functions from named exports (#3693) (8af2b01), closes #3693
